name: browser-tools
description: Task-level browser tools that compose the governed Core browser tool: evidence capture, structured extraction, and deterministic UI checks
author: Sidekick

default_allowed_hosts.description: Host ceiling applied to sessions opened by this pack's tools (*.example.com patterns supported). A per-call allowed_hosts may narrow it but never widen it. Narrows egress policy; never widens it.

allow_private_network.description: Default for whether this pack's tools may request private/loopback egress. Still requires the Core operator ceiling SIDEKICK_BROWSER_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK=true. Off by default.

full_page.description: Default for full-page screenshots in web_capture.

max_text_chars.description: Default bound on captured visible text in web_capture.
